name: Nagan AI Sales Chat
author: mooshshay

sections.description:
Nagan is an AI sales assistant for online stores and business sites. It reads the public products and policy pages of your site, and then answers your visitors in natural Hebrew: it recommends the right product, shows product cards with price and an add-to-cart link, answers shipping and returns questions from your own policy pages, and hands the conversation to you with the visitor’s details when a person is needed.

This plugin connects your WordPress site to the Nagan service:

  • Open a 14-day free trial from the plugin’s settings page. The chat is live on your site about a minute later. No credit card.
  • Works with WooCommerce stores (the product catalog is read from the public WooCommerce Store API) and with service sites (the bot is built from the site’s own text).
  • The chat is loaded asynchronously in the footer and does not block page rendering.
  • A private page shows you the conversations, the leads and the product clicks.

The trial covers 14 days and up to 100 conversations. After the trial the chat keeps working on a free plan of up to 30 conversations a month; a paid plan from the Nagan service removes the limit.

עברית: נגן הוא בוט מכירות AI לחנויות אונליין ולאתרי עסקים. הוא לומד את המוצרים ואת דפי המדיניות של האתר שלכם ועונה לגולשים בעברית, 24/7: ממליץ על מוצר, מציג כרטיסי מוצר עם מחיר וקישור הוספה לסל, ועונה על שאלות משלוחים והחזרות. 14 יום ניסיון חינם, בלי כרטיס אשראי.

External services

This plugin relies on the Nagan service, operated by Sound Check (sound-check.co.il). It cannot work without it.

  • When an administrator presses “Start the free trial” and confirms the consent box, the plugin sends the site address, the e-mail address and the mobile phone number entered in the form to https://nagan-hub.mooshshay.workers.dev/api/provision. The service then reads the public pages of the site and its public product catalog in order to build the bot, and Sound Check may contact the administrator about the trial.
  • Once a bot is connected, the plugin loads the chat widget script from https://nagan-hub.mooshshay.workers.dev/w.js on the public pages of the site. When a visitor uses the chat, the messages the visitor writes, the address of the page they are on and a random session identifier are sent to the service so that it can answer. Details a visitor chooses to leave in the chat (for example a name and a phone number) are stored so that the site owner can get back to them.

Nothing is sent before an administrator opens a trial or connects a bot ID.

Terms of use: https://www.sound-check.co.il/terms/
Privacy policy: https://www.sound-check.co.il/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings > Nagan AI Chat.
  3. Enter your e-mail and mobile phone, confirm the consent box and press “Start the free trial”. If you already opened a trial on the Nagan site, paste your bot ID instead.
sections.faq:
Does it cost money?

The first 14 days (up to 100 conversations) are free and need no credit card. After that the chat keeps working free of charge, up to 30 conversations a month; a paid monthly plan removes the limit. Prices are published at https://www.sound-check.co.il/ai-chatbot/

Which sites does it work with?

WooCommerce stores and service sites whose pages are publicly readable. Sites that block automated reading are set up by the Nagan team after you sign up.

Which languages does the chat speak?

It is built for Hebrew and also answers visitors who write in English.

How do I remove the chat?

Press “Remove the chat from this site” on the settings page, or deactivate the plugin.
